nodes.name: Calendar Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: One endpoint for HubSpot meeting workflows (shared secret) and Calendly webhook subscriptions (signed).

nodes.name: Validate Intake
nodes.notes: Shared secret or Calendly signature, event normalisation and EVENT_DEDUPE_DAYS de-duplication. Needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto.

nodes.name: Raise If Misconfigured
nodes.notes: Fails the execution after a 503, so the error branch alerts.

nodes.name: Build Manual Batch
nodes.notes: Demo: bundled events. HubSpot mode: MANUAL_TEST_MEETING_IDS.

nodes.name: Load Config & Route
nodes.notes: Validates configuration and pins one clock for the run.

nodes.name: Run Demo Pipeline
nodes.notes: Fictional records behind mock HubSpot, Calendly and Twilio. No network.

nodes.name: Enforce Sandbox & Plan Reads
nodes.notes: Stops unless the portal is a sandbox or developer test account (SANDBOX_MODE=true).

nodes.name: Plan Calendly Invitee Lookups
nodes.notes: Calendly no-show payloads that carry only the invitee URI are resolved to an email.

nodes.name: Calendly: Get Invitee
nodes.notes: GET the invitee (only https://api.calendly.com URIs). Header from $env.CALENDLY_API_TOKEN.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Read Meeting or Contact
nodes.notes: HubSpot events: the meeting with contact and deal associations. Calendly events: the contact by email.

nodes.name: HubSpot Meeting Status Filter (No-Show Check)
nodes.notes: Keeps only meetings whose hs_meeting_outcome is in NO_SHOW_OUTCOME_VALUES, and Calendly no-shows that match a HubSpot contact.

nodes.name: Decide Re-Engagement Plan
nodes.notes: Deal stage policy, channel router decision, contact stamp and rep task content for every no-show.

nodes.name: Plan Deal Stage Updates
nodes.notes: Open deals only; never moves a deal backwards unless ALLOW_BACKWARD_STAGE_MOVES=true.

nodes.name: Re-Engagement Email/SMS Router
nodes.notes: Plans one SMS per no-show routed to SMS (consent, number, hours, sandbox recipient already checked).

nodes.name: Twilio: Send Re-Engagement SMS
nodes.notes: Twilio Messages API. The account SID and credentials come from $env at request time.

nodes.name: Plan Email Sequence Enrollments
nodes.notes: Only with EMAIL_PROVIDER=hubspot_sequence. With hubspot_workflow the contact stamp starts the email workflow.

nodes.name: Plan Contact Re-Engagement Stamps
nodes.notes: Writes status, last re-engaged at and no-show count. "email_triggered" enrols the contact in the HubSpot email workflow.

nodes.name: Plan Rep Follow-Up Tasks
nodes.notes: One HIGH priority task per no-show, associated with the contact (204) and deal (216).

nodes.name: Finalize Run
nodes.notes: Run summary and daily counters. Fails the execution if any write failed, after the others were kept.

nodes.name: Build Redacted Failure Alert
nodes.notes: Redacts tokens, SIDs, webhook URLs, phone numbers and emails.

parameters.content:
## No-show re-engagement pipeline: safety defaults
- **Demo mode** while HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN is a placeholder: fictional records, mock HubSpot, Calendly and Twilio.
- **DRY_RUN=true**: decides everything, writes and sends nothing.
- **SANDBOX_MODE=true**: refuses production portals; SMS only to SMS_SANDBOX_RECIPIENT.
- SMS needs explicit consent, a usable number and the allowed hours. Email respects the opt-out property.
- Cooldown per contact, event de-duplication, redacted failure alerts.
